source.rule: StockAllocation may reference a top-level Prelife PLID for an item; PrelifeData rows with explicit QTY are ordered and the Prelife Log preserves that order, allowing stocked physical items and later PM to be tracked individually.

hypothesis_before_native: Native Prelife Log lists stocked physical LRU ages in PrelifeData row order. The original installed LRU first PM occurs h80 in both arms. The first stocked replacement is expected to reflect row-order age10 versus70; if monitored PM age persists after issue, age70 may produce another PM before h140 while age10 may not. Numeric IDs and actual issue order require native observation.
predeclared_native_acceptance: Guarded session-0 SSH CLI completes five steps with zero errors/notes and only reviewed warnings, exact populated-table roundtrip, sealed source/raw evidence, GUI PID13340 preserved and Prelife Log option restored NO. Any new warning is diagnostic.
Pair differs only by order of the two PL-STOCK PrelifeData rows plus description; both QTY1 and ages10/70 are retained, with all other business tables identical.

Native Prelife Log prints installed and stocked individual ages, and event log identifies which stocked physical item is issued at first h80 LRU PM. Subsequent PMs, if any, are attributed to observed physical identity; no assumption that stock row order equals issue order is accepted without events.
At 140 hours, 280 contiguous half-hour System/Stock report bins reconcile with PM, stock and terminal state. No missions or resource booking are expected.
A separate reviewer independently replays source and raw evidence without importing author validation code.
limits: One system, one monitored LRU, two initial same-type spares with fixed CALHOURS ages, one seed and finite 140-hour horizon; no general inventory selection priority or other Prelife patterns.
GUI visual behavior and cross-engine parity are unverified.
